steps.en: Install the CLI and open the local workspace
steps.zh: 安装命令行并打开本地工作区

steps.en: Choose a model, target agent and published benchmark with a baseline
steps.zh: 选择模型、目标代理和已有基线的评测集

steps.en: Request optimization with runs, target score and round limit
steps.zh: 指定重复次数、目标分数和优化轮数

steps.en: Snapshot a reference and evaluate candidate harness changes
steps.zh: 快照参考版本，评测候选框架改动

steps.en: Keep a higher-scoring candidate or restore the reference
steps.zh: 保留涨分候选，否则恢复参考版本

value.en: Harness edits become versioned experiments instead of unmeasured rewrites
value.zh: 框架改动成为有版本的实验，而非无法衡量的重写
